contributions.statement: Ground LLM-generated API fuzz inputs in the OpenAPI spec and check responses with functional/response-difference oracles rather than 5xx-only.
contributions.evidence: §4.3 and Table 8 challenge mapping; no pooled effect sizes; recommendation is the authors' interpretive synthesis.
relative_to: spec-based REST API testing with semantic oracles

reason: A 20-study mapping with no quantitative synthesis; its advice (use the spec, avoid 5xx-only oracles, report cost) is established API-testing practice.
